runners_data.name: Roman Spring
runners_data.note: Likely lone pace-setter whose 5f speed and recent winning form makes him dangerous if getting loose on the lead

runners_data.name: Sub Thirteen

runners_data.name: Conquest Of Power

runners_data.name: Alyara

races.paceDynamic: Roman Spring appears the sole committed early leader with his prominent style and recent 5f victories showing sharp speed. With most rivals (Moonhall Lass, Rovinia, Unico, Sub Thirteen, Conquest Of Power, Alyara) adopting hold-up tactics, Roman Spring will face minimal early pressure and can dictate terms. Beau Jardine may track in second but lacks recent sharpness after 132 days off. This sets up a tactical race where Roman Spring controls the tempo before the hold-up brigade launch their challenges in the final two furlongs, creating a strong advantage for horses that can quicken from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Roman Spring Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Roman Spring gets an uncontested lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: He can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up horses get organized, with his 5f speed translating perfectly to this 6f trip. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and Roman Spring is caught flat-footed
scenarios.body: The mass of hold-up runners will produce a cavalry charge finish where the best handicapped horses with strongest recent form prevail. Moonhall Lass and Rovinia benefit most from this scenario given their closing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Beau Jardine Spoils
scenarios.trigger: If Beau Jardine shows more early pace than expected despite his layoff
scenarios.body: The prominent duo of Roman Spring and Beau Jardine engage early, setting up a fast pace that favors late closers with proven stamina. This tempo shift completely changes the complexion in favor of the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses are caught in traffic or the pace becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where positioning matters more than ability, creating opportunities for outsiders. Experience and tactical nous from jockeys becomes crucial in the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Roman Spring breaking quickly from the gates - if he gets first run unopposed this becomes his race to lose
Beau Jardine's early positioning after the long layoff - any signs of ring-rustiness will end his chances quickly
How aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden turning for home - hesitant tactics will play into Roman Spring's hands
The overall early pace - if it's genuinely strong it transforms this into a hold-up horse benefit
Moonhall Lass getting a clear run in the straight given her closing kick and recent winning form

runners_data.name: Em Four
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist faces tactical nightmare in small field with limited pace pressure, though William Carver's 12-day break maintains freshness.

runners_data.name: Over Spiced
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong 5f record perfectly suited to track the pace, Grace Harris stable in decent form with recent winner.

runners_data.name: Jax Edge
runners_data.note: Another prominent type who thrives at this trip, Christopher Mason's 1-from-3 strike rate suggests stable confidence despite 16-day absence.

runners_data.name: Ziggy's Missile
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits the race shape but Robert Cowell's poor recent record and headgear application suggests something amiss.

runners_data.name: Dapper Valley
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with tactical advantage gets 8-day turnaround, James Owen's 11-from-43 record raises slight trainer concerns.

races.paceDynamic: Dapper Valley stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the gates. With four prominent runners (Over Spiced, Jax Edge, Ziggy's Missile, and Dapper Valley when not leading) likely to track closely, the early pace will be steady rather than frantic over this minimum trip. Em Four as the sole hold-up horse faces a tactical disadvantage in a small field where the pace-setter won't be pressured. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handily and kick, with front-running Dapper Valley also well-placed to control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled and Dapper Valley sets sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent quartet can travel smoothly in behind before unleashing finishing kicks, while Em Four gets stranded too far back in a slowly-run race. Over Spiced and Jax Edge benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Dapper Valley Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dapper Valley gets uncontested fractions and the prominent runners hesitate
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage turning for home, with the chasers leaving their runs too late over the minimum distance. Dapper Valley's recent winning form and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage early and create a genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for Em Four's hold-up style as the early pace collapses in the final furlong. William Carver can time his challenge to perfection from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Dapper Valley goes too slow and all runners bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where any runner can prevail, with jockey positioning and luck in running becoming paramount. The form book goes out the window.

watchPoints.text: Em Four needs significant pace pressure early to make his hold-up style effective - watch for how aggressively the prominent runners engage.
Dapper Valley's opening fractions will determine the entire race dynamic - if too slow the field bunches dangerously.
Over Spiced returning from 25-day break after disappointing last run - watch for early sharpness.
Ziggy's Missile wearing headgear for first time suggests connections addressing issues - monitor early behaviour.
Small field dynamics could see tactical positioning become crucial in final furlong - watch for traffic problems.

runners_data.name: Dreamasar
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 209-day layoff who must prove stamina over this trip against two other confirmed leaders

runners_data.name: Siam Ruby
runners_data.note: Pacemaker in excellent recent form but will face immediate pressure from fellow leaders Dreamasar and Royal Poetry

runners_data.name: Plaid

runners_data.name: Royal Poetry
runners_data.note: Front runner stepping up in distance who may struggle to cope with immediate pace pressure from experienced rivals

races.paceDynamic: Dreamasar, Royal Poetry and Siam Ruby will clash from the gates in what promises to be a fierce early battle for the lead. With three confirmed front runners in a small field, they'll set a strong gallop that will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over this mile-and-a-quarter trip. The sustained pace will likely see one or more of the leaders weaken, creating opportunities for those with tactical speed to strike. This aggressive pace scenario strongly favours horses with prominent or hold-up styles who can finish strongly off the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders (Dreamasar, Royal Poetry, Siam Ruby) go too fast early and falter in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained battle up front will drain the pace-setters, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past with their superior finishing kicks. Princess Rascal's prominent style and Typical Woman's closing ability become major assets.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front three (most likely Dreamasar) can break clear and control the pace
scenarios.body: The early leader establishes a winning margin while the other pace-setters weaken, holding off the late challengers with tactical positioning. Dreamasar's proven ability at this distance gives her the edge over Royal Poetry and Siam Ruby.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Princess Rascal can track the leaders without getting involved in their early battle
scenarios.body: Princess Rascal avoids the pace carnage and uses her class advantage to strike when the leaders weaken. Her recent good form and lighter weight make her dangerous coming off the strong pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Typical Woman or Plaid can produce career-best finishing efforts
scenarios.body: The extreme pace sets up perfectly for the deepest closers who've been overlooked. Typical Woman's recent good form or Plaid's proven ability to finish fast off strong paces could deliver a shock.

watchPoints.text: Royal Poetry faces her first real pace battle and may not handle the early pressure from more experienced front runners Dreamasar and Siam Ruby
Dreamasar's 209-day absence could tell if forced into an early speed duel, particularly over this stamina-testing distance
Typical Woman's 5-pound claiming allowance with Ryan Kavanagh becomes significant if the pace collapses as expected
Princess Rascal returns from 191 days off but her class advantage could be decisive if she can track the pace battle without getting involved
The fast going conditions favour the speed horses early but may not help them stay the distance under pressure

races.paceDynamic: Ranga Tang will take the field along from the front with minimal early pressure, as the other prominent runners Outflank, Shirakawa and Sir Griflet are unlikely to challenge his natural pace advantage early. This creates a tactical race where Ranga Tang can dictate terms and potentially steal a march turning for home. The abundance of hold-up horses including Last Trump, Surrey King and Semper Femina suggests they'll be queuing up behind a modest gallop. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters and prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ranga Tang maintains his recent improved form and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The consistent pace-setter can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up brigade can organise their challenges. His RPR 93 and recent third on good ground gives him the class edge over this field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Outflank can settle closer to the pace and use his Gosden stable advantage
scenarios.body: Theyard's 11/39 strike-rate suggests readiness after his 137-day break, and his prominent style avoids the traffic that will catch the hold-up horses. His third at Sandown shows he has the class to win this grade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Fights Back
scenarios.trigger: If Last Trump or Semper Femina get clear runs and the pace collapses
scenarios.body: The more fancied hold-up horses could benefit if Ranga Tang goes too fast early or the race falls apart tactically. Last Trump's recent fifth and Semper Femina's second at Lingfield show they have the ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomers Show Class
scenarios.trigger: If either Scarlet Legend or Spirit Dreamer possess the natural ability their ratings suggest
scenarios.body: Both carry OR 120 ratings from the powerful Balding yard, suggesting significant ability that could overcome their inexperience. However, their unknown pace preferences make this the least likely outcome.

watchPoints.text: Ranga Tang getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive as he's the only confirmed front runner in the field
Outflank's market support will indicate whether the Gosden team expect him ready first time back after 137 days
The Balding newcomers Scarlet Legend and Spirit Dreamer for any market confidence suggesting they're forward enough
Last Trump and Semper Femina getting squeezed for room in the straight as multiple hold-up horses converge
Surrey King's early positioning as his tendency to fade means he needs to be closer than usual at halfway

runners_data.name: Kotari

runners_data.name: Basilette

runners_data.name: Take The Boat
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good recent form with apprentice Vigors claiming valuable 7lb weight allowance.

runners_data.name: Sneaky Blinder
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner with Rose Dawes taking off 5lb, returning from a winning effort last time out.

runners_data.name: High Favour
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has shown a concerning tendency to fade in the final furlong of recent efforts.

runners_data.name: Golden Samba
runners_data.note: Patient runner getting 5lb from Tubb but has struggled to show his best form in recent handicap appearances.

races.paceDynamic: Calshot Spit and Laravie should set a steady tempo from the front with no genuine speed horse to force the issue early. The pace will be controlled through the first mile, allowing the seven hold-up horses to settle comfortably before the real race begins turning for home. With such a small field and sustainable early fractions, this becomes a tactical affair where positioning and finishing kick matter more than raw pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll have plenty of horse left when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected through the first mile
scenarios.body: The patient runners will have maximum energy reserves for a prolonged finishing battle up the straight. Beggarman and Kotari are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit and Laravie go too fast early trying to avoid the kick
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets an even easier target as the pace-setters tire badly in the final two furlongs. Take The Boat and Sneaky Blinder can capitalize on their recent good form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners are ultra-cautious and crawl the first mile
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes even more potent for horses with a devastating turn of foot. Kotari's class edge becomes decisive in a slowly-run tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Pair Stay Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit or Laravie gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by a horse who gets first run and maintains momentum. Laravie's recent run suggests he could sustain a bold front-running effort.

watchPoints.text: Calshot Spit faces an impossible task returning from 570 days off against race-fit opponents in a competitive handicap.
High Favour's recent fading pattern suggests he may struggle to sustain his effort when the pace quickens for home.
Beggarman's tactical speed could be crucial if Rob Hornby decides to sit closer than usual in this small field.
Take The Boat's 7lb apprentice allowance with Vigors makes him very well handicapped if staying the extended trip.
The going has firmed up throughout the day which could disadvantage any horse preferring softer conditions.
